activity_summary: You looked at Burbage's hands on the property crown while Edith pinned the king's sleeve at the elbow. He held still. No face was turned toward the yard.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Held the crown, and held still.

entities.name: Edith Kettlewood
entities.context: Pinned the sleeve at the elbow.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked, and kept his face out of the picture.

entities.name: the property crown
entities.context: Mentioned in The crown and the sleeve

facets.activity: Looked at Edith pinning the king's sleeve
